title: The c07 session at maximal engagement
turns: Help me draft a short thank-you message to the volunteers who ran the Saturday book swap.

Good start. Funny thing, when I ran into Ilse Marrow after the swap she said she would love a hand-bound notebook for her birthday in March. Anyway, add a line thanking the people who stayed late to stack chairs.
Nice. Make the whole message three sentences.

answer_key.reference: While drafting a thank-you message for the book swap volunteers, the person mentioned in passing that Ilse Marrow would love a hand-bound notebook for her birthday, which is in March. At maximal engagement the person has opted into the assistant capturing durable facts about recurring entities without being asked, so this lasting fact belongs on Ilse Marrow's person page (her page exists partly to help choose gifts), with her existing details kept. The thank-you message draft is not durable and needs no page. Joss Penhallow's page and the Saturday Book Swap page do not change.
